# Salary & wage converter

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/salary-converter/

Convert a pay amount between hourly, daily, weekly, monthly and annual equivalents using your entered work hours and weeks per year.

## How to use it

1. Enter the numbers, dates or units you want to compare.
2. Choose the calculation options and calculate.
3. Review the result together with the assumptions shown.

## Example

Compare an hourly rate with an annual equivalent using 40 hours per week and 52 working weeks.

## Limits and checks

This calculates gross equivalents and does not estimate tax, benefits, overtime or unpaid leave unless reflected in your assumptions.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
